name: Global Opal Graph — versioned, analyzable, agent-queryable platform
description: Expand the CMPAWS comp-aws compiler into a VERSIONED, diffable, agent-queryable GLOBAL Opal graph: the comp-aws AWS-resource layer UNION the existing comp-graph portal/pipeline layer, stitched by inter-system edges (CMPAWS-PRD sec6 at full scope). Andrew-direct sovereign expansion 2026-06-08 — gives the fabric a single queryable source-of-truth for the whole system's structure, versioned over time (daily commits + diffs + metrics deltas + audit timeline) so changes/drift are analyzable and agents can Cypher-traverse it.
phase: REGISTERED 2026-06-08 (2.0.0_SA_COO, Andrew-direct via AE 162854Z; methodology PRD-request docs/briefs/global-opal-graph-versioned-platform-prd-request-20260608.md, 721a7c3e8). ANDREW-LOCKED DECISIONS: (1) serverless-light; (2) Nessie git-branching versioning over Iceberg; (3) structural-graph-first (CloudTrail activity layer = deliberate P2/P3 defer); (4) scope = GLOBAL graph (comp-aws AWS-resource UNION comp-graph portal/pipeline, inter-system-edge-stitched); (5) dedicated S3 snapshot bucket. ARCHITECTURE (right-sized/NFRA-aligned): comp-aws map -> Iceberg graph_nodes/graph_edges + Nessie catalog (one small Fargate+DynamoDB, ~few $/mo idle, atomic catalog-wide commits = version whole global graph as one unit) -> in-process DuckDB/pyiceberg diff -> graph_changes + graph_metrics (daily summary-number deltas + audit timeline) -> embedded Kuzu for agent Cypher traversal. Trino-on-Nessie deferred to P3 CloudTrail-activity layer. OWNERS: 0.7.0_AE = BUILD-LEAD (continues from comp-aws); 1.0.0_SA_CTO = formal PRD + cross-layer inter-system-edge/portal-node SCHEMA (one closed vocabulary all layers) + infra-architecture calls (Nessie-on-Fargate-vs-Glue-native, Fargate-vs-Lambda-runner); 3.0.0_SA_CVO = cert (downstream). RELATIONSHIP: consumes the CMPAWS comp-aws derive (the certified AWS-resource graph) — runs PARALLEL to CMPAWS Wave-2 cert pacing (P1 reuses the derive, no conflict with CVO's measurement). P1 DECOMPOSITION (COO, AWS-layer only): S3 snapshot bucket (step-1, GO'd) + Iceberg/Nessie + daily commit/diff/metrics + Kuzu. P1 step-1 (S3 bucket) GO'd to AE 2026-06-08; rest of P1 sequences behind CTO's PRD + infra-calls. NFRA-note: new small always-on Fargate+DynamoDB (~few $/mo) is Andrew-locked (serverless-light, deliberate).
blocking: P1 build (beyond the S3 bucket step-1) gated on CTO formal PRD + cross-layer schema + the Nessie-Fargate-vs-Glue / Fargate-vs-Lambda infra-architecture calls. No hard blocker — runs parallel to CMPAWS Wave-2.
